query:
SELECT
            a.id as "id",
            COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label) AS "full_name?",
            jsonb_build_object('label', r.label, 'id', r.id) AS "room: RoomEmbed"
        FROM
            accounts_people a
            LEFT JOIN res_leases l ON a.id = l.tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN res_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.id WHERE TRUE AND COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label) ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR r.label ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'  ORDER BY r.label DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
